| ID | Where | Finding |
|---|---|---|
| **F8** | [`content/blog/secrets-management-tools-guide/index.md` L93](https://github.com/pulumi/docs/pull/21885/files#diff-17a53d789fd640d692beea2565f9063cfb0cc8e6202d0975ded5792839f6d8caR93) | *"Pulumi ESC's dynamic credential approach eliminates entire categories of security risk by ensuring credentials expire automatically and can't be misused over…"* — verdict: framing-drift; framing: overclaim. The source says to issue short-lived credentials and prefer OIDC where supported, but the post says it guarantees credentials expire automatically. The PR only adds a link on this line and the overclaim was already there. Decide whether to accept it as-is or soften it to "short-lived credentials that expire automatically". |
